title: Quando ero bambina
summary: Childhood memories by the sea, told in the imperfetto.

sentences.l2: Quando ero bambina, abitavo in un piccolo paese vicino al mare.
sentences.en: When I was a child, I lived in a small village near the sea.

sentences.l2: La nostra casa era vecchia ma grande, e aveva un giardino con un albero di limoni.
sentences.en: Our house was old but big, and it had a garden with a lemon tree.

sentences.l2: Ogni mattina andavo a scuola a piedi con mio fratello.
sentences.en: Every morning I walked to school with my brother.

sentences.l2: Il pomeriggio facevamo i compiti e poi giocavamo in strada con gli altri bambini.
sentences.en: In the afternoon we did our homework and then played in the street with the other children.

sentences.l2: D'estate andavamo sempre al mare: nuotavamo, mangiavamo il gelato e non volevamo mai tornare a casa.
sentences.en: In summer we always went to the beach: we swam, ate ice cream and never wanted to go home.

sentences.l2: Mia nonna cucinava ogni domenica per tutta la famiglia.
sentences.en: My grandmother cooked for the whole family every Sunday.

sentences.l2: Faceva la pasta a mano e la casa aveva sempre un profumo buonissimo.
sentences.en: She made pasta by hand and the house always smelled wonderful.

sentences.l2: Un giorno, quando avevo dodici anni, siamo andati a vivere in città.
sentences.en: One day, when I was twelve, we moved to the city.

sentences.l2: Ma ancora oggi, quando sento il profumo dei limoni, penso a quella casa.
sentences.en: But even today, when I smell lemons, I think of that house.

a.en: to, at, by (a piedi = on foot; a mano = by hand)

avevo.en: (I) had (avevo dodici anni = I was twelve)

andati.en: gone, went (andare a vivere = to move)
